title.narrative: DG-Reform funded project "AI-Ready Flemish Public Administration" is designed to support Flanders (Belgium), and more specifically governments in Flanders, to design, develop and implement reforms; and to prepare, amend, implement, and revise its national recovery and resilience plan pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2021/241.

description.narrative:
The Digital Flanders Agency (DV) has launched an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Competence Center (AI CC) tasked with enhancing and guiding the adoption of AI across Flemish public administrations. The AI CC has developed principles for trustworthy AI, which are currently defined at a high level and require additional definition and practical implementation to make them more concrete and operational for use by Flemish public administrations. Furthermore, the capacity and capability of the AI CC need to be strengthened to empower it to fulfil its coordination role among Flemish public administrations in the facilitation and implementation of AI projects.
The project aims to foster Flemish public administrations’ AI-readiness and increase the adoption of AI across the Flemish public administrations in a safe, robust, trustworthy, and ethical manner. Through its three outcomes, the project focuses on (i) strengthening institutional capacity for AI governance, (ii) technical capacity for AI projects, and (iii) human capacity for AI awareness, literacy and skills, within the Flemish public administrations.
